context: 8 Conclusion We have provided an elementary account of a form of distributed strategies by choosing only to represent the rigid images of concurrent strategies. Is anything irredeemably lost through this simplification? (In the sense that it can’t be regained through adding extra structure, in the way that probabilistic structure recovers hidden branching.) Not obviously. Though, for M FC S 2 0 1 7 instance, we couldn’t exactly reproduce the result of [3], establishing a bijection between events of a strategy and derivations in an operational semantics. Though an elementary account is more accessible, a more abstract, categorical account can be helpful too. As often, there are pros and cons. To some extent, one pays for the elementary treatment in not seeing the abstract picture, the wood for the trees.
